_readme: mode switch. "lineup" = no set times yet: the board is the lineup poster built from slots[].row (head | alpha | battle | host; battles pair up via vs). "timetable" = the KO26-style set-times poster: fill stages{} (key: {name, word, short, sub, host, color}), give every act slot stage + start + end ("h:mm", pm assumed), add ceremony slots with special:true, then set mode to "timetable". Picks and KR songs carry over (matched by artist name). Leave mode out and it flips by itself once any slot has start/end. poster: when set, the lineup board is HSU's own lineup poster (src, w, h in px) with a clickable block over each act at slots[].box = [x, y, w, h] in poster pixels. Remove poster to fall back to the built tiles.

poster.alt: HSU Events' EPIK 2026 full lineup poster
